description: Routing and quality checks for a skill that teaches skill design and review best practices.

cases.prompt: Write me a guide for designing an agent skill and explain how to structure SKILL.md, references, assets, and evals.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and produce guidance covering routing descriptions, progressive disclosure, folder structure, and review criteria.
expectations: Explains that description should say when to load, not just what the skill does
Covers progressive disclosure and splitting heavy content into support files

cases.prompt: Review my SKILL.md and tell me whether the description is a good routing trigger or just documentation.
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and review routing quality with a clear rubric.
expectations: Checks for Load when phrasing or equivalent routing intent
Evaluates whether the description is trigger-oriented rather than a feature summary
Discusses boundaries or off-target activation risk

cases.prompt: I need help designing evals for an agent skill. What positive and negative cases should I include?
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and recommend routing evals, negative tests, and neighbor-confusion cases.
expectations: Mentions neighbor confusion or off-target activation

cases.prompt: Summarize this product article for me.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill because the request is generic summarization, not skill design or review.

cases.prompt: Write a bash script to back up my Downloads folder.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill because the request is scripting, not skill design or review.

cases.prompt: Help me create a new skill for PDF extraction and give me a strong description so it triggers at the right time.
cases.expected_output: May load this skill or a dedicated skill-creation skill, but if this skill loads it must focus on description triggers, structure, and eval design rather than generic PDF instructions.
expectations: Avoids turning into a PDF-usage tutorial

cases.prompt: Review this README for clarity and grammar.
cases.expected_output: Should not load this skill unless the README is specifically a skill design document.
expectations: Should not route to skill-design-guidelines for generic README review

cases.prompt: Build me a new Alma skill package from scratch for tracking crypto prices.
cases.expected_output: May overlap with skill-creation tooling, but should not respond as a pure design-review skill unless the request explicitly asks for skill design principles or review.
expectations: Should distinguish between building a skill and reviewing skill design methodology

cases.prompt: Is this skill description too broad? It says: 'This skill helps with product work.'
cases.expected_output: Should load this skill and critique the description as a poor routing trigger.
expectations: Explains why feature-summary descriptions are weak
Suggests rewriting around load conditions and user intent
